title: 2013 Starbucks Candy Cane Hot Cup Teal And Red With Lid
descriptionText: This 2013 Starbucks Candy Cane Hot Cup is a perfect addition to your Starbucks collection. The cup features a beautiful teal and red color combination with a lid to keep your drink hot. It is perfect for coffee and tea lovers who enjoy their drinks in style. The cup is made by Starbucks, a renowned brand in the food and beverage industry, making it a great collectible item. Add this item to your collection today!
